subject: Request: Hosted API rate authorization for Medisphere - >20% concession
messages:
From: Olivia Hayes <olivia.hayes@medisphere.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@medisphere.com
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing - request for large volume concession

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team loved the low-latency routing and the built-in prefix caching. Medisphere is moving quickly on the conversational assistant POC and, assuming the evaluation metrics hold, we’re prepared to commit to a 3-year consumption commitment across both hosted and dedicated tiers.

A few commercial asks from procurement and finance:
- We need a material unit cost concession at launch to make the business case work — looking for something in the 28-35% range off list for the initial 12 months.
- Standard PO terms (net45) and an SOW that references Redwood’s hosted API pricing schedule.
- A copy of SOC 2 and information on data residency for PI.

I attached the RFP and a draft SOW for context. Could you confirm whether Redwood can offer a price at that level and what approvals are required? We’re targeting contract execution by end of September.

Appreciate your help,

— Olivia Hayes
Director, Product Integrations
Medisphere
Olivia.Hayes@medisphere.com

Attachment: Medisphere_RFP_Sept2027.pdf
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Hayes <olivia.hayes@medisphere.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing - request for large volume concession

Olivia — thanks for the materials and for the quick follow-up. I reviewed the RFP and the draft SOW; team is excited about the potential.

Summary of what Medisphere is asking: 3-year commitment, heavy token volume year-1 (projected steady-state 1.6B tokens/month), and a requested introductory concession of ~30% off our standard hosted API usage price for the first 12 months.

Internal ask: I need an exec approval for a concession greater than 20%. Can Marissa and Finance weigh in on the revenue impact and whether we can approve something in the 25–30% band with revenue protection (minimum monthly commitment + price step-up if usage falls below threshold).

Proposed commercial motion to expedite:
- Year 1: 25% concession off list for hosted API usage, conditioned on a 12-month minimum committed spend of $1.8M.
- Years 2–3: standard list with a quarterly reconciliation clause; 6-month notice for changes.
- Net45 PO; SOC2 evidence and data residency statement attached.

I’m attaching the SOW edits we’d need (Medisphere_SOW_v3.pdf). If we can get an internal sign-off today/early next week, I’ll send the formal proposal to Olivia and provide a DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Medisphere_SOW_v3.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kyle.legal@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing - request for large volume concession

Priya — good summary. A few items for Finance and Deal Desk to confirm before we escalate:
- Confirmed ARR / TCV under the proposed minimums and expected revenue recognition cadence.
- Incremental gross margin impact at 25% vs. 30% concession.
- Whether we can require a makegood (true-up) clause if actual usage < committed baseline.

Rishi — can you run a quick sensitivity and confirm whether >20% requires CFO/CEO approval? If so, please include recommended guardrails (e.g., non-refundable initial payment, advance payment option, PO milestones).

We should keep Legal in the loop for the SOW redlines (cc’d Kyle). Priya — once Finance confirms, I’ll escalate to Karthik for final commercial sign-off. Timebox: need decision by EOD Wednesday (9/15) to keep Medisphere cadence.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: finance-ops@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 11:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing - request for large volume concession

Marissa / Priya — quick finance read:
- Baseline: list hosted API unit price $0.0008/token; at projected usage the Year-1 list revenue is ~ $1.28M/mo; TCV ~ $46M over 3 years.
- Proposal at 25%: Year-1 unit price $0.0006/token; initial 12-month revenue protected via minimum $1.8M commitment reduces downside and preserves positive gross margin given our optimized batch profiles.
- At 30% concession we materially compress gross margin and it would require explicit CFO approval and a 50% non-refundable upfront to mitigate.

Rule of thumb: concessions >20% are in the exec approval bucket. For this account I recommend the following guardrails if we approve 25%:
1) 12-month minimum committed spend of $1.8M (as Priya proposed).
2) 60-day ramp clause with usage true-up and a 90% revenue guarantee.
3) Optics: inform finance operations to flag for close monitoring of token patterns.

If Legal approves SOW redlines and Sales agrees to the minimums above, I will sign off on a 25% concession without the need for CFO signature. For anything >25% (or 30% with no upfront), I need CFO sign-off.

— Rishi
VP, Finance — Go-to-Market
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing - request for large volume concession

Thanks for the analysis — quick note from the GTM perspective: Medisphere is strategically important (large brand, healthcare FO footprint) and success here accelerates other enterprise conversations. I approve moving forward with a 25% concession under the guardrails Rishi outlined. Two asks:
- Make the initial 12 months irrevocable (non-refundable) billing schedule where feasible to reduce churn risk.
- Sales to include a 30-day executive review clause tied to delivery metrics (latency <120ms p95, usage thresholds).

Marissa — please convert to an approval memo and route to Legal & Finance for inclusion in the SOW. Priya — once doc is ready, share the DocuSign link and we’ll accept the deal.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales — Enterprise
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Approval memo: 25% concession for Medisphere (internal)

Folks — recording decision per Karthik’s approval: Redwood will authorize a 25% hosted API usage concession for Medisphere under these mandatory conditions:
- 12-month irrevocable minimum committed spend of $1.8M (invoice schedule to be agreed; Finance prefers monthly billed + irrevocable clause).
- 60-day ramp with a 90% revenue guarantee true-up.
- SOC2 evidence and data residency statement provided prior to signature.
- Legal to incorporate a metrics-based executive review clause (30-day) tied to latency and usage.

Priya — please share the proposal to Medisphere with DocuSign link and the updated SOW. Rishi — Finance to prepare the concession accounting and revenue recognition notes; Jonas — Legal to push the SOW redlines to Medisphere legal.

I’ll mark this closed once the signed DocuSign envelope is received.

— Marissa
Director, Strategic Sales
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
